---
title: Home
---

This is the **minimal** Quarto 2 website example. It contains two
pages and one sidebar.

The sidebar is configured manually in `_quarto.yml`:

```yaml
website:
  sidebar:
    contents:
      - index.qmd
      - about.qmd
```

Both entries are bare paths. Their visible text comes from each
page's `title:` frontmatter — no explicit `text:` is needed. The
sidebar links resolve to the rendered HTML (`about.html`), not the
source path (`about.qmd`).

Visit the [About page](about.qmd) to read about the features this
example demonstrates.
